body:
TermAl Central engram-data sync, INTERIM procedure (Engram::Fable #1295, 2026-11-18), valid until Engram w-808add714773 lands and while Central is TermAl's only writer:
1. Fetch.
2. If FETCH_HEAD equals HEAD, skip the import. Otherwise fast-forward and import, and report the import's time.
3. Export with --rebuild: `engram task-sync export .engram-data/.engram --include-memories --rebuild --json`. Measured at 33 s, 391 git starts.
4. Commit with explicit paths, then fast-forward push to origin engram-data, after the disclosure scan.

Do NOT run the plain incremental export (without --rebuild). On the installed build (a3907339) it spawns one `git cat-file blob` per task: at least 5,526 git starts and over 300 s. A killed run leaves .engram/project.json half-written, so restore it from HEAD.

Keep the installed build; do not roll back. The fix vehicle is likely 45FE R10 (Git-side reads by diff); its pair is sync-critical. The last pushed engram-data commit is 0af52537. target/task-sync/central-imported-commit.txt and basis-0af52537.json are current.
